independent_inventory.source: Official Berlin Denkmale WFS https://gdi.berlin.de/services/wfs/denkmale, type denkmale:denkmale
independent_inventory.region_query: bbox13.335,52.474,13.492,52.568 in CRS84, outputEPSG25833, count10000; verify no pagination/truncation
independent_inventory.spatial_filter: Include footprints touching5km disk, even ifcentroidoutside; exclude any canonical site containingclockorigin

types_exclude.Ensemble: administrative urban-ensemble boundaries, not a physical landmark unit

independent_inventory.canonicalization: Group all features by root eight-digit official id. Then merge strict geometric containment clusters, including nested garden/structure sites; do not doublecountnestedunits. Keep constituent IDs/types; partial overlaps stay separate with explicit limitation.
independent_inventory.bounded_metadata_sample: After spatialfilter/canonicalization select first200 sites sorted by SHA256 of sorted constituentofficialIDs joined bycomma. Independentofbearingandallpriorcorridorlandmarks; no manually added sites. If fewerthan200 takeall. This is a bounded subset of official heritage inventory, not all regional landmarks or a random significance sample.
independent_inventory.chronology: Fetch official linked rootrecord for each constituentid with atmost250pages total,4concurrentreads,15secondtimeout, failuresremainunknown; select representativeprimaryroot bylowestid first, completeothermembers untilcap. Parse primary record's Fertigstellung/Datierung year/range only; pre1990existence requires at leastone such field with latestyear<=1989. Entwurf alone isnot completedexistence. Explicitpost1989primarydatesexcluded from historicalproxy; ambiguous dates/unfetchedpages are uncertain. No axis-conditioned extra research.

history_strata.H0: Independentlyverifiedpre1990outline; none automatically inferred from current WFS. Previously axis-selected historicaloutlines not imported to inflate target score.
history_strata.H1: Officialrecord pre1990existence confirmed, modernfootprint only; primary descriptive proxy, not verifiedhistoricgeometry.

metrics.primary: Count each canonical historicalproxy site once if either pairedray exactly intersects the closed footprint within0..5000m, no hitbuffer. Also report ENE-side and WSW-side directionalcounts.
metrics.types: Separate gardens/broadgrounds from compactbuilt/monument units; classify combinedmulti-typeclusters as mixedcomplex. Officialtyp doesnot reliablydistinguish individualmonument versus institutionalbuilding; preservethatlimit.
metrics.comparison: One180degree orientationcycle, 0.00..179.99 step0.01deg including67.5. Same inventory/range onallbearings; fixedlocalwindow57.5..77.5degrees. Count, median, maximum, targetrank withties andequalorhigherangularfraction. Nearby orientations are correlated robustnesschecks, notindependenttrials.
metrics.convergence: Repeat grid0.02degrees; prefer analytic angularintervalevents to avoidscorealiasing. Geometrydensification5m primary,2.5m convergence. Borderline changesreported; no buffer used as primarymetric.
metrics.sensitivity: Fixed5m and10m perpendicular-distance buffers, only as sensitivity. If exact metric buffering isnot robustly implementable with availabledependencies, omit those scores and explicitly reportlimitation, not substitute an undeclared angularbuffer.

geometry.native: OfficialEPSG25833 ETRS89/UTM33N polygons, all multipolygon rings/holes retained.
geometry.geodesic: WGS84Vincentydirect/inverse in Pythonstdlib; nativeUTMinverse then origin-centeredazimuthal-equidistant mapping makes geodesic rays radial. Densify nativepolygonedges<=5m andmapsegments; derive radial angularsupport from segmentsclippedto5kmdisk, includingholeboundaries andorigininsidefilledpolygons. Closed-boundarycontacts count. Numericapproximations explicitlyreported, not surveyedexactness.
geometry.validation: Independent WFS reprojection reference coordinates, UTMroundtrip, equatorial and meridional geodesic controls, polygonholes/multiparts/tangencies/endpointdiskclipping/centroidoutside/nestedsitecontrols; brute force raysegment oracle for syntheticpolygons andangularintervals.
geometry.coordinate_limit: WGS84 versus ETRS89 epoch differences and sourcepolygonaccuracy unresolved; treat nearby tangencies as numerical/map-sensitive.
